resources.string: Drapco ADB Service Tool will back up your contacts (.vcf file) and text messages (.xml file) to the Download/Backup folder. After the computer downloads them, the files are deleted from this device and this app is uninstalled. Nothing is sent over the internet.

Drapco ADB Service Tool has copied a backup to this device. Restore your contacts and text messages with the buttons below. When finished, tap Done – the computer will delete the temporary files and uninstall this app.
The app needs access to Contacts and SMS – accept the system dialogs.
No access to SMS – only contacts will be backed up (or grant the permission).
No access to contacts – only SMS will be backed up (or grant the permission).
No permission to write to storage – accept the system dialog.
Accept the permissions in the system dialogs to make a backup.
Permissions are blocked. Opening app settings – enable Contacts and SMS, then come back here.
Exporting… do not close the app.
Done ✔ (%1$s).\nThe computer is now downloading the files – you can go back to the computer.
No permission for Contacts and SMS – nothing to back up
No backup files found in Download/Restore.
Allow access to files so the backup can be read.
The contacts app is importing %1$d contacts – confirm there if asked and wait until it finishes.
Allow access to contacts to import them.
To restore SMS, this app must temporarily be the default SMS app – confirm in the next dialog.
The default SMS app was not changed – SMS cannot be restored.
IMPORTANT: set your usual SMS app (e.g. Google Messages, Samsung Messages) as the default again – tap “Restore default SMS app”.
When you have finished, tap Done.
Done ✔ The computer is cleaning up – you can go back to the computer.
This app is still the default SMS app. Restore your usual SMS app first, or tap Done again to finish anyway (it will be switched back automatically after uninstall).
This is a temporary service tool and cannot send messages. Set your usual SMS app as the default again.
If Android says the setting is restricted: open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
